editorial.blurb: A neighborhood gem where bold flavors and craft cocktails make every meal feel celebratory, whether you're marking a special occasion or just craving expertly prepared food.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Garlic Peppery Shrimp and arrive early on busy nights—portions are generous enough for leftovers, and their cocktail menu (try the Guava-tini or Jungle Bird) is worth lingering over.
signatureDishes: Crab and Cream Cheese Crispy Rolls
